newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index sheds 2.51 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index sheds 2.51 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was down 2.12 points, or 2.51 percent, at 82.50 on Monday after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index provisionally fell 110.27 points to 3,765.77.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 13.70 percent from 13.61 percent on Friday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
